**Finding submitted: deviation (GOVLAW).**

- **Responsive locations inspected:** §28.1 (p0103), §28.2 (p0104), §28.3 (p0105); document-wide searches for governing law, jurisdiction, venue, and arbitration returned no other responsive text (no arbitration clause exists).
- **Problem:** §28.1 imposes Singapore law and exclusive Singapore jurisdiction — outside the accepted list and walk-away territory — and it contradicts §28.2's exclusive New York County venue.
- **Cure (preferred level, one surgical replace):** §28.1 now reads "This Agreement is governed exclusively by the laws of the State of New York." The conflicting Singapore forum wording is deleted; §28.2's venue and its customary temporary-injunctive-relief carve-out (which does not defeat the exclusive merits forum) are left untouched and cover the second preferred element as already met. §28.3's escalation mechanic is unaffected.
